}

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  document.querySelectorAll("a[data-target-tab]").forEach(function (link) {
    link.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var targetName = link.getAttribute("data-target-tab");
      var topTabset = document.querySelector(".panel-tabset");
      if (!topTabset) return;
      var tabs = topTabset.querySelectorAll(":scope > ul.nav-tabs > li > a");
      tabs.forEach(function (tab) {
        if (tab.textContent.trim() === targetName) {
          tab.click();
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
        }
      });
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
